purpose: Human technical/live-market explanation database for AUTOHAWK reports. Information only; it does not change scoring, filtering, HOT/GOOD/CHECK or scanner gates.
rules: Use this database to explain why a found car can be good or bad.
Do not promise certainty. Use words like possible, likely, needs inspection.
Engine, gearbox, generation, TUV and body condition matter more than broad model name.
Cheap price is interesting only if the reason is not engine, gearbox, documents or structural rust.
